title: Counting Palindromes
source_topic: ICPC / The 2019 Asia Danang Regional Contest
statement: Given a positive integer n up to 10^18, a prime p of at most one thousand, and a residue k below p, the task is to count how many palindromes have exactly n digits and leave remainder k when divided by p, modulo 1000000007. Palindromes are non-negative integers without leading zeroes that read the same in both directions, so the digit count rules out enumerating them.
